{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=4|time=15 minutes|difficulty=2
}}{{recipe}}

In New Orleans, where Bananas Foster was invented, they'll bring out a hot plate and make the dish table side, including a spectacular flambé. 

== Ingredients ==
* 4 slightly unripe [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]], peeled and halved lengthwise
* {{convert|2|oz|g|abbr=on}} semisweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] [[Cookbook:Zest|zest]], finely [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ¼ cup (50 g / 1.8 oz) [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* ½ teaspoon freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]
* ½ teaspoon freshly-grated [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
* ½ teaspoon freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 1 tablespoon pure [[Cookbook:Vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]]
* [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|Powdered sugar]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients except bananas, powdered sugar, orange, and rum in a large [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] over medium high heat.
#Once mixture comes to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], add bananas, making sure to keep at least ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (1.3 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) between them. Cook for 1 minute per side.
#Remove bananas from pan and keep warm. Bring mixture again to a strong boil over high heat. Turn off the heat and add rum. If rum has not ignited by itself, do so carefully either with a firestick or a long fireplace match. Wait until flames die out before stirring in zest.
#Spoon sauce over bananas and dust with powdered sugar. Serve warm with some ice cream.

steps.text: Combine all ingredients except bananas, powdered sugar, orange, and rum in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Once mixture comes to a boil, add bananas, making sure to keep at least ½ inch (1.3 cm) between them. Cook for 1 minute per side.

Remove bananas from pan and keep warm. Bring mixture again to a strong boil over high heat. Turn off the heat and add rum. If rum has not ignited by itself, do so carefully either with a firestick or a long fireplace match. Wait until flames die out before stirring in zest.
Spoon sauce over bananas and dust with powdered sugar. Serve warm with some ice cream.
